style: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a completely NEW original animation sprite sheet for Monkey D. Luffy in a One Piece roguelike. Crisp detailed 16-bit pixel art, black outlines, flat clustered cel shading, matches retro anime fighting game sprites. Exactly FOUR complete full-body figures in one horizontal row, equal-width cells separated by generous EMPTY gutters. All face RIGHT. Genuine transparent alpha background. No text, grid, labels, background, scenery, extra characters, detached limbs or floating fists. Same character scale in all four cells; game code will apply growth. Every limb must fit inside its own cell. Wide 3:1 image. Each pose anatomically clear with exactly two arms and two legs. The fourth is a unique hurt recoil pose, not another attack. Subject and ordered poses:

assets.luffy: BASE LUFFY: lean black-haired young pirate, straw hat, open RED sleeveless vest, blue cuffed shorts, yellow sash and sandals, no Haki and no steam. 1: lively tilted boxing guard with confident grin. 2: twist torso back, draw ONE rubber arm far behind him at waist height, other hand by chin. 3: GOMU GOMU NO BAZOOKA: BOTH rubber arms extend straight together to the RIGHT ending in exactly TWO open palms pushing forward, readable long rubber forearms, leaning into double palm blast. 4: knocked backward off balance, one hand holding hat, other on chest.
assets.luffy2: GEAR 2 LUFFY: slim athletic black-haired pirate, open red vest, blue shorts, sandals, pink-red flushed skin, straw hat hanging behind neck, small WHITE STEAM ribbons. 1: low crouched one-hand-on-knee Gear 2 stance with determined grin. 2: coiled sprinter crouch loading his legs, two fists drawn back. 3: JET WHIP: explosive low horizontal sweeping KICK to RIGHT with ONE elongated rubber leg and sandal, opposite leg bent under body, hands balancing behind, light steam streaks connected to torso. 4: skids back on one bent knee, forearm bracing ribs and steam dissipating.
assets.luffy3: GEAR 3 LUFFY: lean black-haired pirate, open red vest, blue shorts, yellow sash, sandals, straw hat on back. Exactly one inflated SKIN-COLORED arm and fist, other arm normal size. 1: wide guard resting his ONE HUGE round inflated fist by his right side, other small fist at chest. 2: lift the huge fist OVERHEAD and backwards in a hammer windup, normal arm out for balance. 3: GIGANT HAMMER: lean forward dropping the giant SKIN-COLORED fist DOWN AND RIGHT to ground level, bent balloon arm clearly connected to shoulder, normal hand behind him. No extra fists or arms. 4: recoils sideways, giant arm droops to floor, normal hand shielding face.
assets.luffy4: GEAR 4 SNAKEMAN LUFFY, NOT Boundman. Lean muscular human-proportioned torso and long legs, wild longer black hair flaring upward, bare chest with X scar, NO balloon belly. Dark red shorts with fluffy pale cuffs, purple waist sash, bare feet or sandals. Both forearms and fists glossy BLACK Haki with RED flame patterns, slim white STEAM scarf around shoulders. Exactly two arms. 1: low wide grounded martial artist guard, black fists by jaw, fierce grin. 2: twist waist and pull ONE black fist back beside hip loading a fast strike, other fist guards face. 3: PYTHON / BLACK MAMBA: ONE black-and-red rubber arm extends to RIGHT along a clear angular zigzag like a striking snake, ending in one clenched black fist; other arm remains tucked beside torso. Keep continuous connected zigzag arm, no extra fist, no duplicated arm, no actual snake head. Torso stays lean and both feet planted. 4: steps back bracing ribs with one fist, other forearm shielding face, steam trails. All four poses new and distinctly Snakeman. Complete figures within separated cells.
assets.luffy5: GEAR 5 NIKA LUFFY: white fluffy cloud hair, white eyebrows, laughing face, white open shirt and white shorts with fluffy cuffs, purple sash, sandals, white cloud scarf looping behind shoulders, bare chest X scar. Attack MUST be a STOMP not a punch. 1: carefree laughing upright pose, one hand on belly and other pointing forward. 2: GIANT STOMP windup: standing on ONE leg, lift the other bent knee VERY HIGH toward chest, arms raised and spread playfully, sole visible below lifted knee. 3: GIANT STOMP impact: lean body forward, slam ONE HUGE stretched bare lower leg and sandal DOWN AND RIGHT, sole flat at floor level, other leg planted beneath body, both hands open raised for balance. Exaggerated oversized foot is the focal point, no punching. Same overall body scale across cells: runtime enlarges full body for giant transformation. 4: silly rubber recoil backward with both arms curved up, one eye squeezed shut, cheeks puffed. Exactly two legs total; one stomp foot and one supporting foot. Keep entire figure and giant sandal within cell.
